title: Food, Drugs, and Tech—100 Years of Public Health

reader_summary.headline: The federal agency known as the FDA, or the Food and Drug Administration.
reader_summary.overview: The federal agency known as the FDA, or the Food and Drug Administration, was born over 100 years ago—at the turn of the industrial revolution. The same could be said to be just as true today. From CRISPR to synthetic biology to using artificial intelligence in medicine, our healthcare system is undergoing massive amounts of innovation and change.
